title: CHOKE GROUPS
author: irpina
description: Choke groups for the Digitone mk1 and Digitone Keys: a note on a track silences what the other tracks of its group are still playing, as an open hi-hat is cut by a closed one. CHK on TRIG's second page (press TRIG twice) puts the track in group A-D or none, per pattern, and p-locks per trig (hold the trig and turn). A choked voice fades out over one block (0.7 ms). OS 1.43 and 1.44 (it names no firmware address: its 1.44 port is empty). Needs core-dn1 5.1 (its lane parameters, TRIG's second page and the notes the sequencer builds).
